Dirt Sleeper Sound Board

Every sound but the engine is new, rebuilt from scratch. Pick a scene, solo a sound, try its versions. The engine runs underneath exactly as the Digital Engine lab plays it. New sounds are off in the game until you approve them; copy the mix code into the game to hear them there.

Mix code

  1. Press Copy mix code.
  2. In the game, press Tab while driving (or Pause → Tuning and sounds), open Sounds, press Paste a code. Settings → Sound mix takes it too.
  3. The code holds which sounds are on, every level and version. Changes save here automatically.
